The noble Goldmask lamented what had become of the hunters. How easy it is for learning and learnedness to be reduced to the ravings of fanatics; all the good and the great wanted, in their foolishness, was an absolute evil to contend with. Does such a notion exist in the fundamentals of Order?
effects: Alleviates and cleanses accumulated Death Blight status buildup on the caster. It does not restore Hit Points (HP) and cannot prevent death once the Death Blight meter is completely filled. The incantation is not chargeable, cannot be channeled or continuously cast, and must be cast from a stationary position on foot, though it can be performed while mounted on horseback. Deals 0 damage, applies no offensive status effects, and affects only the caster without extending to allies.

name: Noble Presence
description:
Ancient power of the Godskin Nobles.

Thrust out belly with gusto to produce a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes.

Charging enhances potency, knocking enemies into the air.
effects: Thrusts out the caster's abdomen with force to emit a close-range concussive shockwave that repels surrounding enemies and deals pure Fire damage while applying the Black Flame damage-over-time effect, which drains a percentage of the target's maximum HP over several seconds. The incantation can be charged to increase damage and stance damage (from 16.8 to 21.84), expand the shockwave radius, and launch human-sized foes high into the air rather than simply knocking them backward; charging increases the FP consumption from 20 to 36. It cannot be channeled or continuously cast. The spell receives a 20% damage bonus when wearing the Godskin Noble Robe, but notably does not receive the 10% boost from the Godslayer's Seal. It additionally benefits from generic fire-boosting effects such as the Fire Scorpion Charm and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, along with the Godfrey Icon when charged.

name: Order's Blade
description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks.
This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason—all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
effects: Enchants the armament held in the right hand with Holy damage for 90 seconds. The added Holy Attack Power scales exclusively with 0.75x (75%) of the Faith portion of the Sacred Seal's Incantation Scaling, ignoring any Intelligence, Strength, or Arcane scaling from hybrid seals. Deals +100% bonus damage against Those Who Live in Death and completely prevents undead skeletons from resurrecting when felled. This incantation cannot be charged, cannot be channeled or continuously cast, and cannot be cast while mounted on horseback. It can only be applied to weapons that allow affinity buffs (Standard, Heavy, Keen, or Quality paths, and select innate buffable weapons), and cannot be applied to elemental- or status-infused weapons. The added holy damage benefits from holy damage enhancing effects, such as the Sacred Scorpion Charm and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

name: Magic Fortification
description:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Increases magic damage negation.
This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me—the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.
effects: Grants a body buff that increases magic damage negation by 35% (10% in PvP) for 90 seconds. Can be cast while in motion or while mounted on horseback. Does not inflict or build up any status effects. Cannot be charged or continuously channeled. As a body buff, it does not stack with and will overwrite (or be overwritten by) other body buffs such as Flame, Grant Me Strength, Boiled Crab, Barrier of Gold, or other Fortification incantations. It stacks multiplicatively with aura buffs (such as Golden Vow), shield buffs, health regeneration effects, and damage negation talismans like the Spelldrake Talisman. The duration can be extended to 117 seconds with the Old Lord's Talisman.

name: O, Flame!
description:
Incantation of the Fire Monks, drawn from the Giants' Flame.

Momentarily sparks a roaring flame from the caster's hand.
Charging enhances potency.

Fire beguiles those who gaze into it. And so the guardians of the flame are also its worshippers.
effects: Unleashes a roaring burst of fire directly in front of the caster, dealing pure Fire damage across a wide close-range area. The spell can be charged to significantly increase damage output, hit volume, and stance damage. Unlike Catch Flame, it cannot be chain-cast or performed immediately out of jumps or rolls, but deals substantially greater single-hit burst damage. It does not inflict status effects, but can reset the Frostbite status on enemies. The incantation is classified as a Giants' Flame / Fire Monk spell, receiving a 20% damage boost from the Giant's Seal. When charged, it receives a 15% damage bonus from the Godfrey Icon. It also benefits from the Fire Scorpion Charm, Flock's Canvas Talisman, the Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and the body buff Flame, Grant Me Strength.

name: Magma Breath
description:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a wyrm to spew magma breath.
Allows one follow-up attack.

Those who have performed the Dragon Communion will find their humanity slowly slipping away. Once they fully succumb to their fate, they are left no more than wyrms that crawl the earth.
effects: Transforms the caster into a Magma Wyrm to spew molten lava forward, creating pools of magma on the ground. Deals Fire damage upon direct hit as well as continuous Fire damage to targets standing in the lingering magma. Cannot be charged, but allows for one follow-up attack by pressing the attack button again, consuming additional FP and stamina. Cannot be cast mid-air while jumping, though it can be cast while mounted on Torrent. Does not inflict status effects, but can reset Frostbite with its fire damage. Damage is boosted by the Dragon Communion Seal, Roar Medallion, Fire Scorpion Charm, Faithful's Canvas Talisman, Flock's Canvas Talisman, and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

name: Pest Threads
description:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Secretes countless sticky threads, launching them forwards.

A technique of the pale pests who crawl through the lands afflicted by scarlet rot; the abandoned children of the goddess.
effects: Releases two volleys of sticky projectile threads that track the target, dealing pure Physical damage. The threads pierce enemies and can hit repeatedly as they travel through large hitboxes. The spell cannot be charged or channeled, but can be cast repeatedly in succession and while mounted on horseback. Despite being a Servants of Rot incantation, it inflicts no Scarlet Rot or Poison buildup.

name: Protection Of The Erdtree
description:
A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship.

Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies.
Hold to continue praying and delay activation.

In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
effects: Casts a defensive aura that grants a Body Buff to the caster and nearby allies, significantly increasing damage negation against all non-physical damage types (Magic, Fire, Lightning, and Holy). In PvE, it provides a 30% reduction to incoming non-physical damage; in PvP combat, this damage negation is reduced to 10%. It provides no damage negation against physical damage (Standard, Slash, Strike, or Pierce). The buff lasts for 70 seconds and does not deal damage or inflict any status build-up. The spell cannot be charged to amplify its potency, but holding the cast button allows the player to delay activation while continuing to pray, granting allies extra time to move within range. It cannot be channeled continuously. As a Body Buff, Protection of the Erdtree does not stack with other Body Buffs (such as Flame, Grant Me Strength, Black Flame's Protection, Boiled Prawn/Crab, or specific fortification incantations like Barrier of Gold or Flame Fortification), overwriting or being overwritten by them. It stacks with Aura Buffs (such as Golden Vow), Health-over-time regeneration incantations, weapon armaments, shield buffs, and defensive talismans. Its effect duration is increased by 30% (to 91 seconds) when equipping the Old Lord's Talisman.

name: Poison Armament
description:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison.
This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
effects: Enchants the right-hand armament with poison for 60 seconds (extended to 78 seconds with the Old Lord's Talisman). The incantation does not impart direct physical or elemental damage; instead, it adds a flat 70 poison status buildup per strike. Once triggered, standard poison inflicts damage over 90 seconds (dealing 0.07% max HP + 7 damage per second). The incantation cannot be charged, channeled, or continuously cast, but it can be cast while in motion or while mounted. It can only be applied to buffable right-hand armaments (Standard, Heavy, Keen, or Quality affinities, as well as uninfused weapons that accept armament buffs). Although the 70 buildup does not scale with Sacred Seal incantation scaling or Arcane normally, it uniquely scales with the player's Arcane stat when applied to weapons with innate Arcane scaling that accept buffs (such as the Ripple Blade, Ripple Crescent Halberd, and Varré's Bouquet). Successfully poisoning an enemy triggers bonuses from Kindred of Rot's Exultation, the Mushroom Crown, and the Poisoned Hand, and the poison status can be consumed for burst damage using the Poison Moth Flight Ash of War.

name: Placidusax's Ruin
description:
Power gleaned from the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.

Transforms caster into the Dragonlord to spew golden breath from above. This incantation can be cast while jumping.

These are the dying wails of the Dragonlord who once dwelled eternal beyond time.
effects: Transforms the caster into the Dragonlord hovering in the air to unleash an initial lightning burst followed by sweeping golden breath beams. The initial blast deals Lightning damage and knocks back nearby targets. The ensuing golden breath deals heavy Fire damage over multiple hits, sweeping across the area and launching enemies upwards on the final hit. The beam can be aimed freely in a 360-degree direction during the animation. The incantation can be initiated while jumping, cannot be charged, and plays as a fixed continuous casting animation lasting approximately 8 seconds. It inflicts high stance damage (up to 70 total) with no status effect build-up. Its breath damage is boosted by the Roar Medallion, but because it belongs to neither the Dragon Communion nor Dragon Cult spell groups, it receives no passive school bonuses from the Dragon Communion Seal or Gravel Stone Seal, nor does it benefit from the Godfrey Icon.

name: Poison Mist
description:
Incantation of the servants of rot.

Releases a poisonous mist before the caster.
This incantation can be cast while in motion.

Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well.
The death that begets life, that comes to all equally.
That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.
effects: Releases a short-range poisonous mist cloud with a 2.8-meter radius directly in front of the caster that lingers for 16 seconds. Can be cast while in motion. Deals no direct physical or elemental damage upon contact and does not produce noise or hit stagger, allowing the caster to inflict status without alerting unaware targets or breaking stealth. It cannot be charged and cannot be channeled or held for continuous cast. Inflicts 20 Poison status build-up every 0.2 seconds (100 Poison build-up per second) to enemies inside the cloud, totaling up to 1,600 Poison build-up across its full duration. Poison build-up scales with Arcane when cast using a catalyst with Arcane scaling (such as the Dragon Communion Seal), increasing up to 29 build-up per tick (145 per second, or 2,320 total). Synergizes with items that buff attack power upon poison infliction nearby, such as Kindred of Rot's Exultation, the Mushroom Crown, and the Poisoned Hand.

name: Radagon's Rings Of Light
description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

A gift of gratitude to the young Miquella from his father, Radagon.

Produces a golden ring of light and fires it across a wide area. Charging enhances range.

And yet, the young Miquella abandoned fundamentalism, for it could do nothing to treat Malenia's accursed rot. This was the beginning of unalloyed gold.
effects: Generates a golden halo of light above the caster that expands outward in a wide 360-degree horizontal ring, dealing Holy damage to all enemies within its perimeter. The incantation deals pure Holy damage equal to 310% of Incantation Scaling when uncharged and 395% of Incantation Scaling when fully charged, alongside 10 stance damage (14 stance damage if charged). Can be charged to increase both damage and the area of effect, but cannot be channeled or chained continuously. It inflicts no status build-up. Targets can only be hit once per cast despite the wide ring structure. Its damage is boosted by 10% when wielding the Golden Order Seal (which stacks when dual-wielding), 10% by wearing the Radiant Gold Mask, and 15% when charged using the Godfrey Icon talisman, and it scales with both Intelligence and Faith.

name: Rotten Breath
description:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath.
Charging extends duration.

Those extraordinary individuals who perpetuate Dragon Communion are called the dragon-hearted.
effects: Channels the power of Dragon Communion to manifest a draconic head that spews a wide cloud of rotting breath forward, dealing Standard Physical damage (131% Incantation Scaling per hit, up to 3 hits per breath) and inflicting 65 Scarlet Rot buildup per hit (up to 195 buildup per breath). Holding the cast button channels the incantation to unleash a second consecutive breath attack for an additional FP and stamina cost, allowing for a total of up to 6 hits (390 cumulative Scarlet Rot buildup). Once triggered, Scarlet Rot inflicts damage equal to roughly 29.7% of the target's maximum HP plus 1,170 damage over 90 seconds. Unlike advanced named dragon breath spells, Rotten Breath cannot be cast in mid-air while jumping, but it can be cast while mounted on horseback. Its damage is boosted by 15% per Dragon Communion Seal held, 10% by the Roar Medallion, and 20% by the Rock Heart, and because it inflicts pure physical damage, it benefits from the Blue Dancer Charm.

name: Rejection
description:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Produces a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes.
Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

Hark, Tarnished! If you truly walk in faith, you must be prepared to reject all else.
effects: Produces a shockwave around the caster that deals 0 direct damage but knocks back nearby foes in the direction the caster faces, dealing 180 stamina damage against guarding enemies in PvE (220 in PvP) and 10 stance damage. Can be charged to expand the shockwave radius from 2 meters to 4 meters, dealing 220 stamina damage against guards in PvE (275 in PvP) and 14 stance damage. The incantation cannot be channeled or continuously cast. It causes no status build-up. It is effective for interrupting enemy attacks, breaking enemy poise or guard, rapidly cracking Crystalian defenses, and knocking targets off ledges for lethal gravity damage. While chargeable, it does not benefit from damage-boosting equipment such as the Godfrey Icon due to its lack of base damage.

name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
description:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion.

Channels the power of Smarag, the Glintstone Dragon.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath from above.
Charging extends duration.
This incantation can be cast while jumping.

Smarag was a devourer of sorcerers, and over time, his body became corrupted by their glintstones.
effects: Transforms the caster into the spectral head of Glintstone Dragon Smarag, hovering in mid-air to spew a sweeping stream of glintstone breath downward, dealing heavy Magic damage. Can be cast while jumping in mid-air, but cannot be cast while mounted. Charging the spell extends the initial breath duration, and continuing to channel or pressing the input again triggers a second breath wave, allowing the player to swivel and adjust aim. The incantation inflicts no status effects. Initial cast costs 36 FP and 60 stamina, with extended casting consuming FP continuously (up to 144 FP total for both full waves, requiring at least 79 FP to initiate the second wave) and an additional 60 stamina for the follow-up breath. Damage scales with Incantation Scaling and is boosted by the Dragon Communion Seal (15% per seal), Roar Medallion (10%), Rock Heart (20%), Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and Terra Magica.

name: Stone Of Gurranq
description:
Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

Hurls a boulder before the caster.
This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

Long ago, Gurranq was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his former name meant 'Death of the Demigods.'
effects: Hurls a massive boulder forward in an arcing trajectory that inflicts physical strike damage and heavy stance/poise damage upon impact, creating a small area-of-effect explosion. The incantation cannot be charged, but it can be cast continuously in rapid succession (chain casting) with reduced recovery animations to repeatedly stagger enemies. It inflicts no status build-up. Damage is boosted by the Clawmark Seal (+10%) and the Cinquedea dagger (+10%), scales with Faith (and Strength when using the Clawmark Seal), and synergizes with physical attack buffs such as Flame, Grant Me Strength, Golden Vow, and the Blue Dancer Charm, as well as general incantation-boosting talismans.

name: Surge, O Flame!
description:
Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

Creates a stream of fire to burn the area before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to maintain the effect.

The Giants' Flame is the flame of ruin, capable of burning the Erdtree. And so, following the War against the Giants, its ruinous blaze was sealed, and guardians were appointed to watch over it.
effects: Emits a continuous sweeping stream of fire directly in front of the caster that deals Fire damage scaling with Incantation Scaling (51% per tick, dealing 1 stance damage). The incantation cannot be charged, but it can be channeled continuously by holding the cast button, draining 1 FP and 2 stamina per tick until reserves are exhausted. The caster can move at walking speed while maintaining the stream. While it causes no status build-up itself, its fire damage immediately resets the Frostbite status on enemies, allowing Frostbite to be reapplied repeatedly. Damage is boosted by the Giant's Seal, Fire Scorpion Charm, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and the Flame, Grant Me Strength buff. It can also be maintained indefinitely during the Cerulean Hidden Tear's duration.

name: Shadow Bait
description:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the assassins of the Roundtable Hold.

Creates a pale gold shadow before the caster, luring foes of human build and attracting their aggression. This incantation can be cast while in motion or crouching, and will still affect foes that are already in a combat state.

It is said that those beguiled by the shadow see within it a hated foe.
effects: Casts a pale gold shadow projectile forward that creates an illusory effigy upon landing, attracting the aggression of nearby enemies of human build within a 15-meter radius for approximately 3 seconds. Deals no damage of any type, cannot be charged, cannot be channeled or continuously cast, and inflicts no status build-up. It can be cast while in motion or while crouching, and successfully redirects the attention of valid foes even if they are already alerted or engaged in combat. Effective against human-sized and medium humanoid enemies (such as foot soldiers, knights, Albinaurics, Demi-Humans, Miners, and Omens), but has no effect on beasts, large non-humanoid monsters, or bosses. Synergizes with stealth approaches and backstabs, pairing effectively with talismans like the Assassin's Crimson Dagger and Assassin's Cerulean Dagger to restore HP and FP on critical hits.

name: Scouring Black Flame
description:
A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles.

Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range.

The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
effects: Sweeps a wide area in front of the caster with black flame, dealing Fire damage and applying a debuff that burns away 2% of the enemy's maximum HP plus 20 damage over 2 seconds. Can be charged to increase forward range, damage, and stance damage. Deals pure Fire damage that scales with Faith and Incantation Scaling, boosted by Godslayer's Seal and Godfrey Icon when charged.

name: Scarlet Aeonia
description:
Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.

Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot.

Each time the scarlet flower blooms, Malenia's rot advances. It has bloomed twice already. With the third bloom, she will become a true goddess.
effects: The caster takes flight enveloped in a scarlet bud before diving to slam down onto the ground, dealing Standard physical damage and knocking down foes in a 4-meter radius. A massive scarlet flower then blooms and explodes, inflicting heavy Standard physical damage, high stance damage, and Scarlet Rot in a 5-meter radius. The blooming petals linger for roughly 4.2 seconds, continuously dealing periodic physical damage and inflicting 150 Scarlet Rot buildup every 0.7 seconds (inflicting the potent tier of Scarlet Rot dealing 0.33% max HP + 13 damage per second for 90 seconds). This spell cannot be charged and cannot be chain-cast or channeled. During mid-air ascent and descent, the caster possesses substantial hyperarmor against stagger. Because it deals physical damage, it is boosted by physical damage buffs such as Flame, Grant Me Strength and the Blue Dancer Charm, as well as incantation boosters like Flock's Canvas Talisman. Triggering rot from this incantation activates damage buffs from Kindred of Rot's Exultation and the Mushroom Crown.

name: Swarm Of Flies
description:
A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power.

Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
effects: Releases a slow-flying, tracking swarm of bloodflies directly ahead of the caster. Upon hitting an enemy or surface, the swarm explodes for Standard Physical damage equal to 52% of Incantation Scaling and disperses into a stationary cloud that hits up to 5 times. Each cloud hit inflicts Standard Physical damage equal to 15% of Incantation Scaling and builds up Blood Loss through both an instant flat buildup (70 base) and a bloodflame burn effect (80 buildup over 2 seconds at 4 per 0.1s), totaling 150 Blood Loss buildup per hit (up to 750 across all 5 hits). Each hit also inflicts 1 Stance damage (6 total). The spell cannot be charged and cannot be channeled, but it can be cast while walking or crouching and can be chained into consecutive casts. When cast with the Dragon Communion Seal, the flat Blood Loss buildup scales with Arcane (reaching up to 102 flat, or 182 total per hit at 99 Arcane). Blood loss procs caused by the flies trigger attack boosts from Lord of Blood's Exultation and the White Mask, and its physical damage benefits from physical attack buffs such as Flame, Grant Me Strength.

name: The Flame Of Frenzy
description:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to burst forth from the caster's eyes. Charging increases the range of the burst.

The flame of frenzy deals damage and causes buildup of madness. This incantation also causes buildup of madness in the caster, and is only effective against Tarnished.
effects: Emits a wide spread of frenzied flame projectiles from the caster's eyes that deal Fire damage and inflict Madness buildup on targets, while also causing a smaller amount of Madness buildup on the caster. The incantation can be charged to increase damage, projectile spread, range, and Madness buildup, but cannot be channeled continuously. The Madness status effect only afflicts Tarnished foes and other players. Damage scales with the equipped seal's Incantation Scaling and receives specific bonuses from the Frenzied Flame Seal, Godfrey Icon (when charged), Fire Scorpion Charm, and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear. Self-inflicted or enemy-inflicted Madness triggers synergies with equipment like the Black Dumpling, Madding Hand, and Aged One's Exultation.

name: Theodorix's Magma
description:
Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix.

Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack.

The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.
effects: Transforms the caster into a great magma wyrm to spew a massive volume of molten lava in an arc, dealing heavy Fire damage on direct impact and coating the ground in lingering magma pools for approximately 6 seconds. Targets standing within the magma take continuous tick Fire damage and suffer minor stagger. When hitting targets at point-blank range, both the initial projectile and the resulting eruption connect, dealing double damage. Allows for one immediate follow-up attack by inputting the cast command again before recovery; the second cast consumes stamina rather than additional FP, requiring at least 1 point of stamina to execute. The spell cannot be charged and cannot be continuously channeled. It can be cast midair while jumping, but cannot be used while mounted on horseback. The lava's Fire damage instantly clears Frostbite on enemies, enabling rapid cyclical frost reapplication. Damage scales with Faith and Arcane, and is boosted by the Dragon Communion Seal, Roar Medallion, Fire Scorpion Charm, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and Flame, Grant Me Strength.

name: Unendurable Frenzy
description:
Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion.

It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
effects: Violently channels a continuous, wide spray of the yellow flame of frenzy from the caster's eyes, dealing pure Fire damage and 5 stance damage per projectile. The incantation cannot be charged; instead, holding the input continuously channels the flame barrage at the cost of additional FP (6 per bolt) and stamina, while allowing slow movement. Releasing the input causes the caster to stagger back slightly and discharge a final surrounding burst of flames. Each flame bolt inflicts 40 Madness build-up on targets (affecting players and Tarnished-like humanoid NPCs) while causing 4 Madness build-up on the caster per projectile, which can inflict self-madness with prolonged casting. If cast with the Dragon Communion Seal, the Madness build-up scales with Arcane. The spell's damage is boosted by 20% when using the Frenzied Flame Seal (44% when dual-wielding), and it synergizes with Fire-enhancing buffs (Fire Scorpion Charm, Flame, Grant Me Strength, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear) as well as Madness-triggered effects like Aged One's Exultation, the Black Dumpling helm, and Madding Hand. Cerulean Hidden Tear eliminates FP consumption during the channel, though self-inflicted Madness buildup continues.

name: Triple Rings Of Light
description:
One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly.

A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
effects: Produces three large rings of golden light that fire forward in a wide horizontal spread, piercing through enemies and dealing Holy damage. Upon reaching their maximum range, the rings pause briefly before returning toward the caster's current position, allowing them to strike enemies multiple times. The incantation cannot be charged or channeled, but can be cast repeatedly in rapid succession. It inflicts no status build-up and does not prevent Those Who Live in Death from reviving. Damage is boosted by 10% when cast with or holding the Golden Order Seal, by 15% with the Dryleaf Seal, by 10% when wearing the Radiant Gold Mask, and by holy damage-enhancing gear and buffs such as the Sacred Scorpion Charm and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

name: Whirl, O Flame!
description:
Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

Creates a spiraling stream of fire that burns the area before the caster. Charging enhances potency and reach.

Fire beguiles those who gaze into it. And so the guardians of the flame are also its worshippers.
effects: Unleashes a spiraling stream of fire in front of the caster that deals fire damage. The stream pierces through enemies and can hit a single target up to 4 times, damaging multiple foes lined up in its path. Can be charged to increase damage and double its reach. It cannot be channeled continuously and causes no status buildup. Damage is boosted by the Giant's Seal, Godfrey Icon (when charged), Fire Scorpion Charm, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and Flame, Grant Me Strength.

name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
description:
Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

Summons red lightning to bolster both the caster's body and their armament held in the right hand.

Enchants armament with lightning-affinity attacks and increases maximum equipment load. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced.

Of all the knights, Vyke the Dragonspear was the one Lansseax loved the most.
effects:
Summons red lightning to grant both a weapon buff to the right-hand armament and a body buff to the caster, each lasting 70 seconds. Can only be cast if the right-hand armament is eligible for weapon buffs.

- Weapon Buff: Imbues the right-hand weapon with flat Lightning damage equal to 0.75x of the casting Sacred Seal's Faith-based Incantation Scaling. Intelligence- and Arcane-based scaling on hybrid seals do not contribute to the added damage.
- Body Buff: Increases maximum equipment load by 15% (which can lower equip load burden tiers), but reduces lightning damage negation by 35%.

This incantation cannot be charged, channeled, or continuously cast, and causes no status build-up. Once cast, the weapon and body buffs function independently: swapping weapons removes the weapon enchantment while leaving the body buff active, and applying another body buff will overwrite the equip load and negation modifier without removing the weapon enchantment. Both buff durations are extended by the Old Lord's Talisman.

name: Urgent Heal
description:
Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

Heals a small amount of HP. This incantation can be cast while in motion.

The Two Fingers has high hopes for the Tarnished; that even if they should be wounded, even should they fall, they will continue to fight for their duty.
effects: Restores HP to the caster equal to 115% of the Faith-scaling portion of the equipped Sacred Seal's Incantation Scaling upon completing the casting animation. The healing does not scale with the Arcane or Intelligence scaling of hybrid Sacred Seals and affects only the caster, without healing nearby allies or summons. Urgent Heal deals no damage of any type, including Holy damage, and does not harm Revenants or Revenant Followers. The incantation cannot be charged to boost its potency or delay execution, cannot be channeled or continuously cast, and inflicts or cures no status build-up. Uniquely among standard direct healing incantations, it can be cast while walking in motion. It mechanically synergizes with cast-speed boosters such as the Radagon Icon or high Dexterity, and complements gradual health-recovery effects such as Bestial Vitality for efficient, low-FP health maintenance between encounters.

name: Wrath Of Gold
description:
Superior Erdtree Worship incantation.

Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave.

This incantation was discovered when the Elden Ring was shattered, and it was feared as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.
effects: Releases an expansive golden shockwave dealing Holy damage in an area around the caster that violently knocks back human-sized enemies. Can be charged to increase Holy damage, enlarge the shockwave radius, and deal increased stance damage. It can be cast while mounted on Torrent, benefits from charge-boosting effects such as the Godfrey Icon, and does not cause status build-up or allow continuous channeling.
